round25_result.negative_finding: A global whose PAGE is materialised once into a callee-saved register and reloaded through it is not reproduced by either the plain `volatile` spelling (GCC re-emits the lui per access, 104/80) or the `volatile u32 *` address spelling (GCC folds the offset into the pointer). This is the same family as round-7 00308cd0 and round-11 0030a2d0 and should be added to the parked-class list.
round25_result.picker_assessment: Round 25 scored 0/3 attempted where round 24 scored 5/16 with the same four exclusions in place. Removing the known-bad classes does not make the remaining material reliably easier; the survivors are dominated by callee-saved page registers and explicit `mult`. A future batch should also exclude bodies that materialise a global page into s0/s1.
round25_result.branch_idiom_class: The remaining targets of BOTH rounds 25 and 26 are dominated by branch-structure idioms: beql/beqzl tail skips, a value held live across a branch, and multi-word stack arrays built then passed by address (00192818/00192940 do six lw + six sw). This class is not screened for and should be added to the picker.
